first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. Ashford Borough Council's official Public Register endpoint is directly reachable without login, but the public client-rendered page remains at Loading / Sorry to interrupt / CSS Error in this transport, and a target-specific PA/2024/1920 record, site/location plan, title identifier, cadastral/title polygon or canonical parcel bbox cannot be extracted from this window. Local OpenCode or a browser-capable user-side workflow must retrieve and spatially bind the target-specific application/site plan or authoritative parcel/title geometry; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official Ashford Borough Council Public Register endpoint is a materially different execution method from the prior CON29/live-map guidance window: it attempts the direct client-rendered register itself. The page is public/no-login, but this transport receives only the client shell (Loading / Sorry to interrupt / CSS Error) and cannot obtain a target-specific PA/2024/1920 document or spatial extent. No parcel/title geometry is inferred from the failed client render; spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
